correctness.rationale: For each sign sector, the norm-attainment equation is a nonzero polynomial of degree at most \(p\). The two mixed coefficients exclude an identically zero sector unless they force a scalar multiple of a signed permutation isometry; a zero row or missing column instead contradicts a positive pure-power coefficient. At a maximizing direction the polynomial and its first derivative vanish, so each such root has multiplicity at least two. At most \(\lfloor p/2\rfloor\) maximizing directions lie in any one of at most four sector closures; antipodality gives \(|M_T|\le 8\lfloor p/2\rfloor=4(p-1)\) for odd \(p\).
